## Grip Strength Test Analysis

-- **Illustration:**  
Boxplots and individual scores  

```{r gs_data_loading}

rm(list = ls())

#--------------------------- 1. Manual Entries -----------------------------#
# 1.1 INPUT FILES
file_path <- "~/AOCF-Behavioral Tests/Burrowing test/validation/group data/"

raw_data_file1 <- "170816_group1_Burrowing_test.xlsx"
raw_data_file2 <- "170816_group2_Burrowing_test.xlsx"
raw_data_file3 <- "170816_group3_Burrowing_test.xlsx"

#---------------------------2. LOAD DATA-----------------------------#
# Load data
raw_data1 <- read_excel(paste(file_path,raw_data_file1,sep = ""))
raw_data1$gr <- "gr1"
raw_data2 <- read_excel(paste(file_path,raw_data_file2,sep = ""))
raw_data2$gr <- "gr2"
raw_data3 <- read_excel(paste(file_path,raw_data_file3,sep = ""))
raw_data3$gr <- "gr3"

# Factor the genotype/group/sex variable 
data <- rbind(raw_data1,raw_data2,raw_data3) %>%
  rename(pellets = "# of pellets in tube",
         a_two_hrs = "# of pellets outside (2hr)",  
         b_overnight = "# of pellets outside (overnight)") %>%
  mutate(gender = as.factor(sex),
         gr = as.factor(gr),
         perf_perc = (b_overnight/pellets)*100)          
#         perf_perc = ((b_overnight - pellets)/pellets)*100) 

df <- gather(data, key="time_points", value="values", 5:6) 

list_of_exps <- factor(unique(df$time_points))
list_of_genders <- unique(df$gender)
list_of_groups <- unique(df$gr)

```

### Results

#### Pellets removed

```{r pl_fig1, fig.width = 9, fig.height = 9}

#---------------------------3. ANALYSIS-----------------------------#
# 3.1 Pellets removed
# 3.1.1 At 2 hrs point and overnight

pl_pellets <- df %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = gr, y = values, color = factor(time_points))) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NULL) +
  #add data-points (not overlapping)
  geom_point(position = position_jitterdodge(dodge.width = 0.75), size = 2) +
  #define position of 'n='
  stat_n_text(y.pos = 0) +
  #axis title
  labs(x="", 
       y = "Counts",  
       title = "Number of pellets removed") +
  #add a theme
  theme_pubr() +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("blue", "red")) +
  #legend
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        plot.title = element_text(vjust= 0, hjust = 0.5, size = 12))

#pl_pellets  

pl_pellets_s <- df %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = gr, y = values, color = factor(time_points), fill = gender, label ="")) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NULL) +
  #add data-points (not overlapping)
  geom_point(position = position_jitterdodge(dodge.width = 0.75), size = 2) +
  #define position of 'n='
  stat_n_text(y.pos = 0) +
  #count n of each gender and add it to the plot 
  geom_text(aes(label=after_stat(count), y = after_stat(count)), stat="count", position = position_dodge(width = 0.95), vjust = 6, size=4, show.legend = FALSE) +  
#  geom_text(aes(label=..count.., y = ..count..), stat="count", position = position_dodge(width = 0.95), vjust = 6, size=4) +
  #axis title
  labs(x="", 
       y = "Counts",  
       title = "Number of pellets removed") +
  #add a theme
  theme_pubr() +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("blue", "red")) +  
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("white", "grey80")) +  
  #legend
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        plot.title = element_text(vjust= 0, hjust = 0.5, size = 12))

#pl_pellets_s
  
#arrange the 2 plots created above into a grid with 1 rows and 2 column with automatic labelling (A,B)
Fig1 <- ggarrange(pl_pellets, pl_pellets_s, labels="AUTO", ncol=1, nrow=2, common.legend=F, legend = "bottom")

Fig1

```

__Figure 1.__ Comparison of number of pellets removed between groups (A) and between gender within group (B). 

\newpage

__Statistics for Figure 1 A.__

```{r fig1a stats}

# Stats for Figure 1 (COMPARISON BETWEEN GROUPS)
#create a tibble to collect all stats
stats = tibble()

for (i in 1:length(list_of_exps)) {
  stat_data <- pl_pellets$data %>%
    filter(time_points == list_of_exps[i])
# perform Pairwise Wilcoxon Rank Sum Tests to compare within genotpye difference
st = tidy(pairwise.wilcox.test(stat_data$values, stat_data$gr, exact = FALSE, p.adjust.methods="BH")) %>%
    mutate(method = "Pairwise Wilcoxon Sum",
          variable = "Fig 1 A, pellets removed",
          test = paste("between group for", list_of_exps[i]),  
          sign=ifelse(p.value < 0.05, "*", ""))

#combine stats from every iteration of the loop
stats = bind_rows(stats, st)
}

#format the table
stats%>%
  #remove horizontal lines between rows
  kable(booktabs = T) %>%
  #prevent table from floating and scale it to page-width
#  kable_styling(latex_options="scale_down") 
  kable_styling(latex_options = c("HOLD_position","scale_down"))  

```

__Statistics for Figure 1 B. (Between genders)__

```{r fig1b1 stats}

# Stats for Figure 1 (COMPARISON BETWEEN GENDERS)
#create a tibble to collect all stats
stats = tibble()

for (j in 1:length(list_of_exps)) {
  data <- pl_pellets_s$data %>%
    filter(time_points == list_of_exps[j])
  for (i in 1:length(list_of_groups)) {
    stat_data <- data %>%  
      filter(gr == list_of_groups[i])
    # perform Wilcoxon Rank Sum Tests to compare within group difference
    st = tidy(wilcox.test(stat_data$values ~ stat_data$gender, exact = FALSE)) %>%
      mutate(method = "Wilcoxon Sum",
             variable = "Fig 1 B, pellets removed",
             test = paste("between genders in", list_of_groups[i], "for", list_of_exps[j]),
             sign=ifelse(p.value < 0.05, "*", ""))
    #combine stats from every iteration of the loop
    stats = bind_rows(stats, st)
  }
}

#format the table
stats%>%
  #remove horizontal lines between rows
  knitr::kable(booktabs = T) %>%
  #prevent table from floating and scale it to page-width
#  kable_styling(latex_options="scale_down")   
  kableExtra::kable_styling(latex_options = c("scale_down", "HOLD_position"))

```

__Statistics for Figure 1 B. (Between groups)__

```{r fig1b2 stats}

# Stats for Figure 1 (COMPARISON BETWEEN GROUPS)
#create a tibble to collect all stats

for (j in 1:length(list_of_exps)) {

  for (i in 1:length(list_of_genders)) {
    stat_data <- data %>%  
      filter(gender == list_of_genders[i])
    # perform Pairwise Wilcoxon Rank Sum Tests to compare between group difference
    st = tidy(pairwise.wilcox.test(stat_data$values, stat_data$gr, exact = FALSE, p.adjust.methods="BH")) %>%
      mutate(method = "Wilcoxon Sum",
             variable = "Fig 1 B, pellets removed",
             test = paste("between group in", list_of_exps[j], "for", list_of_genders[i]),
             sign=ifelse(p.value < 0.05, "*", ""))
    #combine stats from every iteration of the loop
    stats = bind_rows(stats, st)
  }
}

#format the table
stats%>%
  #remove horizontal lines between rows
  kable(booktabs = T) %>%
  #prevent table from floating and scale it to page-width
  kable_styling(latex_options="scale_down")   
#  kable_styling(latex_options = c("HOLD_position","scale_down"))

```

#### Pellets borrowing performance

```{r pl_fig2, fig.width = 9, fig.height = 9}

#---------------------------3. ANALYSIS-----------------------------#
# 3.1 Pellets removed
# 3.1.2 Pellets borrowing performance

pl_perf <- df %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = gr, y = perf_perc, color = gr)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NULL) +
  #add data-points (not overlapping)
  geom_point(position = position_jitterdodge(dodge.width = 0.75), size = 2) +
  #define position of 'n='
  stat_n_text(y.pos = 0) +
  #axis title
  labs(x="", 
       y = "Performance (%)",  
       title = "Pellets burrowing performance (%)") +
  #add a theme
  theme_pubr() +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("blue", "red", "green")) +
  #legend
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        plot.title = element_text(vjust= 0, hjust = 0.5, size = 12))

#pl_perf  

pl_perf_s <- df %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = gr, y = perf_perc, color = gr, fill = gender, label ="")) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NULL) +
  #add data-points (not overlapping)
  geom_point(position = position_jitterdodge(dodge.width = 0.75), size = 2) +
  #define position of 'n='
  stat_n_text(y.pos = 0) +
  #count n of each gender and add it to the plot 
  
  geom_text(aes(label=after_stat(count), y = after_stat(count)), stat="count", position = position_dodge(width = 0.95), vjust = 2, size=4, show.legend = FALSE) +  
#  geom_text(aes(label=..count.., y = ..count..), stat="count", position = position_dodge(width = 0.95), vjust = 2, size=4, show.legend = FALSE) +
  #axis title
  labs(x="", 
       y = "Performance (%)",  
       title = "Pellets burrowing performance (%)") +
  #add a theme
  theme_pubr() +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("blue", "red", "green")) +  
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("white", "grey80")) +  
  #legend
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        plot.title = element_text(vjust= 0, hjust = 0.5, size = 12))

#pl_perf_s
  
#arrange the 2 plots created above into a grid with 1 rows and 2 column with automatic labelling (A,B)
Fig2 <- ggarrange(pl_perf, pl_perf_s, labels="AUTO", ncol=1, nrow=2, common.legend=FALSE, legend = "bottom")

Fig2

```
